events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's the 35th anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a true icon. Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and stage presence are still unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The album that changed everything for The Beatles, and for music. Still sounds incredible, 61 years on.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend John Lennon, who passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His music and message continue to resonate around the world.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Genius
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of a true visionary. The Starman's influence is as strong as ever.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. His music is timeless.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page, born in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the man behind some of the greatest guitar riffs ever. Happy Birthday, Jimmy Page!

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary British singer Rod Stewart, born in 1945.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Icon
angles.copy: Still rockin' at 82! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs (Graham McPherson), the iconic frontman of Madness, born in 1961.

angles.name: One Step Beyond
angles.copy: The Nutty Boy himself is 66 today! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Madness frontman Suggs.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Happy 71st birthday to English singer Paul Young, born in 1956.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Still got that unmistakable voice! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, born in 1946, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Enduring Charm
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music and spirit live on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and pop superstar Gary Barlow, born in 1971.

angles.name: Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Still bringing the hits! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Happy 77th birthday to Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Seventy-seven years young for the voice behind some of the greatest soul-pop anthems. Happy Birthday, Billy Ocean!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring icons like Chuck Berry, James Brown, Elvis Presley, and The Beatles.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: Remembering the day rock history was officially cemented. Who was your favourite from the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: He's been part of one of the biggest bands for decades! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Mark Owen.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: The ultimate surprise gig! Remembering The Beatles' legendary rooftop concert, 58 years ago today.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to legendary English musician Phil Collins, born in 1951.

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: From Genesis to solo stardom, a true powerhouse. Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Phil Collins!

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to acclaimed British actor Hugh Grant, born in 1960.

angles.name: British Charm
angles.copy: Still charming us on screen! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the brilliant Hugh Grant.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake, born in 1981.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for 46 years! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the incredible Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to beloved English actor Sir David Jason, born in 1940.

angles.name: Only Fools & Horses Legend
angles.copy: Still making us laugh! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years since we lost three musical pioneers. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, born in 1966.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Still never gonna give us up! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the one and only Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Eighty-two years since the birth of a legend. Bob Marley's message of peace and unity lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to American singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942.

angles.name: Songwriting Royalty
angles.copy: A true master of melody and lyric. Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the incredible Carole King!

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: It's 15 years since the passing of the incomparable Whitney Houston, who died in 2012.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. Remembering Whitney Houston.

events.title: Take That's original split
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop titans Take That announced their split, sending shockwaves through the music world.

angles.name: Pop History
angles.copy: Remember the day the music stopped? Twenty-one years since Take That's original split. Thankfully, they're back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the lead singer of UB40, born in 1959.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Still bringing the reggae vibes! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Happy 36th birthday to global superstar Ed Sheeran, born in 1991.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Thirty-six years young for the man who consistently tops the charts. Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Ed Sheeran!
